corrections.reason: The preposition prefix is በ- ('በቃሉ', matching lines 6-7 and 12); a slightly shortened left leg on the initial በ caused it to be misread as ብ.

corrections.corrected_text: ክት ፡ ታዩ፡ ም ፡ ፲፮ ፥ ፩ ፥ ፫ ። ም፡ ፲፩፥ ፲፰።
corrections.reason: The cross-reference is to Revelation chapter 16 (ም ፡ ፲፮ ፥ ፩ ፥ ፫), where the seven angels pour out the seven plagues; the numeral ፮ (6) was misread as ፻ (100).
Classical Ge'ez pairing 'ገብር ወአግዓዚ' (servant and free man); the printed glyphs clearly show 1st-order አ and 4th-order ዓ with a shorter right leg, which was misread as ወእግዐዚ.
Biblical chapter/verse reference cannot have ፲፻ after ፲; the printed numeral is ፲፪ (Rev 5:9, 12), where ፪ was misread as ፻ due to ink fill.
